Content checks C1, C2, C3 passed in every rollout (4/4 each), confirming the decisions themselves were correct. However, C4 failed in all 4 rollouts and P1 failed in all 4 rollouts. The root cause is that every settlement has empty justification_fact_ids ([]) and empty credited_facts ([]) — the model's settle action only outputs decisions.assignments and never links the revealed facts as justification. P1 (linked to PF1) fails because PF1, though revealed by A2 in every transcript, is never cited in justification_fact_ids (REVEALED BUT UNUSED). C4, which has no linked decisive facts, also fails in all rollouts, likely because it checks for the presence of justification or credited facts in the settlement, which is always absent. This is an ENCODING MISMATCH: the settlement schema or shared_context does not instruct the model to populate justification_fact_ids, so the model produces a bare decisions-only settlement.
